This '''aide''' was a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who assisted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] during his tenure as commander of [[Folor Base]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. The aide&mdash;among other duties&mdash;used to procure [[Abrax/Legends|Abrax]] [[Cognac/Legends|cognac]] for the general.
